policy: Audit-owned candidates only; canonical engineering memory is unchanged.

candidates.title: Every positive terminal state needs one shared promotion invariant
candidates.observation: MILESTONE_EXTERNAL_PASS bypasses assurance checks applied only to READY_FOR_REVIEW and can be self-asserted.
candidates.proposedGuardrail: A table-driven validator test must exercise every positive status against every mandatory red dimension and independent-evidence prerequisite.

candidates.title: A configurable mandatory gate set must be closed and non-empty
candidates.observation: Green Keeper returns PASS when invoked with an empty gate list.
candidates.proposedGuardrail: Reject empty, duplicate, unknown, or incomplete gate sets and validate evidence for the exact canonical mandatory set.

candidates.title: Completeness must be anchored to an independent required-ID set
candidates.observation: The submitted matrix controls its own denominator and one aggregate field is not cross-checked.
candidates.proposedGuardrail: Derive exact required IDs from the versioned specification/preflight and cross-check every aggregate field across matrix, report, and state.

candidates.title: Structured control references must be resolved, not only typed
candidates.observation: Lesson prevention/evidence references and stale preflight membership can be syntactically valid while semantically false.
candidates.proposedGuardrail: Resolve every referenced control/evidence target and recompute deterministic derived artifacts from canonical source data.

candidates.title: Evidence from a dirty tree needs immutable input identity
candidates.observation: Recorded commands pass at the final tag but fail at their declared commits because dirty inputs are not content-bound.
candidates.proposedGuardrail: Record input content hashes or require committed inputs, and enforce monotonic post-seal timestamps and validation.
